title: A new tool server
conventions: follow mcp/config.py: a stdio server declared by an executable and an argument array — never a shell string
declare its tools and their effect classes (read is the only one that needs no per-call approval)
the server is INERT until an operator enables it and selects a tool (discovery is not activation)
acceptance: the server module declares a valid MCP config (argv, no shell) and lists its tools with effect classes; nothing activates on its own
